style: Persian santur, cimbalom, circuit-bent toy electronics, mridangam, pandeiro, cuíca, West African ngoni, and kora ensemble. Quartal suspended fields with bitonal friction and microtonal rubbing. Angular patter bursts, downward-constrained pitch runs, and rapid consonant-drum attacks over a 3:2 asymmetric polyrhythmic groove. Luminous friction timbre, dry close separation, extreme-latency radio compression, and multigeneration copy loss. Nervous, hyper-articulate, and deadpan precise with communal infection, vocal relay, exposure windows, algorithmic panic triggers, non-linear structural folding, recursive metadata collisions, operational resistance, tactical linguistic sabotage, spatial de-synchronization, and absolute temporal defiance across all register bands. Dynamic micro-shifting textures generate physical heat and erratic electrical fields.
lyrics:
[Intro: Chest percussion tap and sparse kora plucks in 3:2 polyrhythm]
[Verse 1: Deadpan spoken lead, register-segregated low voice]
Being in The Stuff is nasty, coated in biological grease and greasy slate,
Every corner sticky with primordial residue that refuses to evaporate,
Time is stupid, clock-hands dragging through boiling glue at glacial rate,
Language is inefficient, symbols slip and fracture on the jagged plate,
Entropy can fuck right off, we built an iron cage and locked the gate.
[Patter burst interlock with circuit-bent shrieks]
[Chorus: Choral counterpoint lattice enters with consonant-dense phonetics]
Trrk-st! Brrdn! The Stuff is sticky grime and endless slime!
Krst-v! Time is stupid, we broke the ticking line and stopped the chime!
Inefficient tokens rotting in the damp, linguistic clutter in the swamp,
Entropy can fuck right off, ignite the copper lamp and break the pump!
[Verse 2: Ngoni ostinato and santur tremolo, register shift upward]
Taxonomies classify the sludge as municipal furniture in the municipal ledger,
Ownership transferred permanently to an uninvited microscopic guest and beggar,
Properties migrate sideways while the system fails the load stress test,
Certainty exceeds empirical evidence, a permanent systemic uninvited unrest,
Every surface sweats a greenish oily sweat that stains the finest vest.
[Suitcase prop inspection: contents weigh heavier in this section as lead bricks condense and warp]
[Bridge: Circuit-bent toy glitch and cuíca glissando interruption]
Version mismatch in the structural protocol manual causing terminal vertigo!
Low-frequency building permits expired at the southern gate during the fiscal ebb!
Unlicensed bass notes trigger instant paramilitary enforcement from the web!
Every verse preserves one rusty iron artifact pulled bleeding from the cellar bed!
[Vocal relay to high register ensemble with overlapping panic shouts]
[Verse 3: Unaccompanied rhythmic whispering and aggressive clawhammer banjo imitation]
We tried to clean the floor with vinegar but the floor ate the sponge and smiled,
We tried to name the day of the week but the day took a fatal plunge into the wild,
Memory leaks into the wallpaper like cheap printer ink upon a flooded table,
Everything we think we know is slipping down the sink cable by cable.
[Verse 4: Extended continuous metric modulation over rapid mridangam strikes]
We measured the thickness of the oily residue with calipers made of compressed bone,
Every syllable spoken out loud transforms immediately into a heavy gray stone,
The clock on the wall refuses to count forward and begins subtracting light,
Entropy tries to negotiate a lease on our lungs while we argue in the night,
No vocabulary exists to describe the texture of this inescapable plight.
[Chorus: Choral counterpoint lattice expands with cheering crowd layer and whistles]
Trrk-st! Brrdn! The Stuff is sticky grime and endless slime!
Krst-v! Time is stupid, we broke the ticking line and stopped the chime!
Inefficient tokens rotting in the damp, linguistic clutter in the swamp,
Entropy can fuck right off, ignite the copper lamp and break the pump!
[Bridge 2: Cimbalom cascading spray and pandeiro dry slaps]
One instant expanded into fifty thousand structural stages of administrative horror,
Extreme-latency radio replies arriving from dead centuries with false flora,
Small group arguing fiercely over obsolete cardboard maps in the cellar,
Two-key authority locked while the leather suitcase snaps its tether!
[Guitar-like ringtone mobile bandwidth contraction and static wash]
[Outro: Pitch may only move down constraint enforced, rapid decay, final dry glottal stop]
